item: Documented exception for step3nl_v4c/runs/P_A and step3nl_v4c/runs/reg_fin13v4b (verifier fin13v4c double-run pass A and the regression against fin13v4b). These two runs are NOT pinned by the step-4 v38 manifest; only runs/P is (review fix15 REVIEW_v4c_interface.md 1.4, A-1r; option 'record an exception note' accepted there; coordinator message of Nov 20 relaying fix16_texts_v38/RECORDS_ERRATA_v38.md).
cause: e2_consts.py pins the text of verifier/constants.py; constants.py was edited after cert pass A, so e2_consts.json and then e2v4b_constants.json changed their bytes (the pin of the edited file), not their numbers; pass A's outputs were later deleted by the driver (stale out_A). runs/P_A and runs/reg_fin13v4b were computed with pass A's e2v4b_constants.json (37386e13...), which no longer exists; runs/P was computed with the current file (7d6ada65...).
numbers: equal: runs/P_A == runs/P and runs/reg_fin13v4b == step3nl_v4b/runs/P apart from timing and args (V4C_REPORT, fix15 review FREV15); re-checked by p2/v38/verify_v4c_runs_with_exceptions.py
scope: only this one pin in those two run directories; every pin of runs/P matches the disk; no rerun (accepted by the fix-15 review)
